items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: No, because now we were at the Pete Lawless working there, Joe Oliver and Johnny Dodge and Mud Carey and oh, just the whole bunch.

ctx.x: Yeah, during the war. And all the night clubs couldn't do any business then. They closed up. So that's how we were able to get all these people to go out of town. They wouldn't have had anything else to do, would they?
No, because now we were at the Pete Lawless working there, Joe Oliver and Johnny Dodge and Mud Carey and oh, just the whole bunch. Yes. And they were going to take some of them to war too, wasn't it?
Well, they did it. They left town. It was made to leave for the afraid of that.
